annotation.evidence_span: unless a deviation is specifically known to be safe
annotation.interpretation_a: Alt-authorities MUST carry the same SvcParams as the origin unless there is documented proof that a different set of SvcParams will not cause issues.
annotation.interpretation_b: Alt-authorities MAY carry different SvcParams than the origin if the implementer believes the change is safe, even without formal documentation.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'specifically known to be safe' is vague. It doesn't define who needs to know, what level of evidence is required, or what constitutes 'safe'. This allows for different interpretations of when a deviation is permissible, leading to inconsistent implementations.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'specifically known to be safe' is missing. What constitutes sufficient evidence to determine safety is not defined, leading to different implementations.
